---
title: "Publications"
format:
  html: default
---

```{python}
import json

with open("../data/publications.json") as f:
    pubs = json.load(f)

pubs = sorted(
    pubs,
    key=lambda x: x.get("year", 0),
    reverse=True
)

types = {}

for p in pubs:
    types.setdefault(
        p["type"],
        []
    ).append(p)

for section in sorted(types):

    print(f"\n## {section}\n")

    for p in types[section]:

        authors = ", ".join(
            p.get("authors", [])
        )

        print(
            f"- **{p['title']}** "
            f"({p['year']})  \n"
            f"  {authors}"
        )
```
